headline:
18,000 Marbella homes
in line to be regularised.
sub: Five things Costa del Sol agents should know this week.
items: Marbella approves its first town plan since 1986: ~18,000 homes on the path to legal status, 20% of new capacity for affordable housing.
Andalucía appraised values hit a record €1,981.6/m², up 13.8% in a year and above the 2008 peak.
Renting a 90 m² flat in Málaga city now takes 38% of household income. Only Madrid is worse.
25 protected homes on Marbella's Golden Mile, €180k–280k. Registration closes 1 October.
Málaga's mayor: no stressed-zone rent cap, and foreign buyers should "compensate economically".
takeaway: If you have Marbella sellers whose paperwork has been a sticking point, this is a good week to call them.
